'''Detention Block 220''' was a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] located aboard the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Guardian (Executor-class)|''Guardian'']]. Several [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] prisoners were held in the detention block until they were rescued during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] capture of the ship.<ref name="TFO">{{JournalCite|15|Two for One}}</ref>
